## Authorized scope

- Compare source plans with actual stage records, snapshots, streams, runtimes, and artifact inventories.
- Classify observed artifacts, failures, restart behavior, reusable parser opportunities, and explicit deferrals.
- Propose compact sanitized provenance for separate review without moving or deleting calculation data.

## Completion criteria

- Every child has an explicit evidence-backed disposition.
- Reusable silicon/QE/Wannier findings are separated from unrelated-material and out-of-scope learning.
- The review identifies follow-up candidates without activating them or claiming scientific validation.

## Exclusions

- The review does not execute calculations, delete or relocate data, or activate successors.
- Cross-tutorial numerical comparison is prohibited without explicit compatibility.
- Passing tutorial runs do not establish production readiness or scientific acceptance.
